name: spaces_list
description: Lean spaces catalog. Share each `webUrl`; call `spaces_show` only for inline canvas preview. Each space has `creationIdentifier` and usually `projectReference` for tags_assign/tags_unassign (Spaces support tags & review status like assets). Group by projectReference when assigning across many spaces. Pass `projectReference` to list the spaces filed in a project, including teammates' spaces for team admins (find projects with `folders_list` `teamProjects`). Do not use `creations_search` for spaces. @see guides_get('spaces')

projectReference.description: Only spaces filed in this project (any team member's for admins).
